text: Cinematic wide shot of a surreal futuristic desert landscape at night. In the lower left foreground, a person in a long red cloak stands beside a fluffy alpaca on a sand dune, both facing away towards a distant city. The background features a glowing metropolis with a central skyscraper topped by a bright cyan neon ring halo. To the left, a skyscraper has vertical neon text reading 'OASIS'. To the right, a purple neon skyscraper glows. Beams of cyan light shoot into a starry sky where a large crescent moon hangs in the upper left. The horizon transitions from deep blue to a warm orange sunset. In the right foreground, a tall saguaro cactus outlined in neon pink stands beside a small turquoise pool of water. A futuristic monorail track curves through the sand with a train on it. Hyper-detailed digital art, sci-fi style, vibrant neon colors, cinematic composition.
